name: Minecraft: Velocity Proxy
description: Velocity proxy for linking multiple Paper/Purpur servers behind one address.

files.velocity.toml:
bind = "0.0.0.0:{{PROXY_PORT}}"
motd = "{{MOTD}}"
show-max-players = 500
online-mode = {{ONLINE_MODE}}

[servers]
lobby = "127.0.0.1:25566"
try = ["lobby"]

variables.label: Velocity version
variables.description: Use latest, or a version such as 3.3.0-SNAPSHOT.
